LanguageData.QN_Event_Storm_Desc: StarCom's satellite array was hit by a solar storm. Quantum Net on this map is temporarily down!\nUntil restored: RimSeek disabled, paid plans suspended, cross-map calls and online shopping unavailable.
LanguageData.QN_Event_Congest_Desc: NebulaCloud data centers are overloaded. Quantum Net is heavily congested!\nUntil restored: RimSeek efficiency greatly reduced.
LanguageData.QN_Event_Sale_Desc: CyberBazaar's annual mega sale begins!\nDuring the event: all private online shopping half price, mood bonus increased.
LanguageData.QN_Event_Carto_Desc: CartoBoard released this year's blockbuster!\nDuring the event: colonists shop online more eagerly (double trigger chance).
LanguageData.QN_Event_Calib_Desc: MineScan completed its annual calibration. Today's prediction accuracy greatly improved.
LanguageData.QN_Event_Promo_Desc: Quantum Net carriers joint promotion!\nDuring the event: all paid plans half price for new subscriptions/renewals.

LanguageData.QN_AI_P2Promo1: [Recommended] Register and use the Player2 app to enjoy all AI features for free!
LanguageData.QN_AI_P2Promo2: Player2 is a free local desktop app, no API Key needed; if installed and running, just check the Player2 config to use it.
LanguageData.QN_AI_P2Promo3: Checked configs are tried top-to-bottom in list order; failures or quota exhaustion auto-switch to the next.
LanguageData.QN_AI_EnableDesc: When enabled, daily Quantum Net data (weather/mine/tips/news) is AI-generated; auto-falls back to defaults if all configs fail.
LanguageData.QN_AI_FreqDesc: Off = no AI requests and no daily report (saves tokens); sent at 12:00 by frequency, requires Quantum Infinite subscribers.
LanguageData.QN_AI_RimTalkCast: Broadcast AI network news via RimTalk (requires RimTalk)
LanguageData.QN_AI_RimTalkCastDesc: After the daily report, a random Quantum Infinite subscriber chats about today's network news/weather/mine forecast via RimTalk.
LanguageData.QN_AI_Providers: Provider configs (check to enable, order = try order):
LanguageData.QN_AI_CfgP2Hint: Player2 local service: no API Key needed. Install and run Player2.
LanguageData.QN_AI_CfgLocalHint: Local model: auto-fails and switches to next config if Ollama is not installed.
LanguageData.QN_AI_LiveDesc: Shows network data currently generated and applied by AI, to verify whether AI really controls Quantum Net.
LanguageData.QN_AI_ForceBtn: Force one AI network request now
LanguageData.QN_AI_ForceDesc: The button above bypasses the once-per-day limit and lets AI generate a fresh set of data shown above, to verify connection and AI control.
LanguageData.QN_AI_JsonDesc: This JSON tells AI what daily Quantum Net data to return. Edit freely; one click restores defaults.
LanguageData.QN_AI_NeedEnable: Enable "AI Network Intelligence" on the AI settings page first.
LanguageData.QN_AI_NoConfig: No provider config checked. Check at least one config below.
LanguageData.QN_AI_InFlight: A request is already in flight, please wait...
LanguageData.QN_AI_Forced: Force request initiated. See the status panel and log above.
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_ConfigEmpty: Config is empty. Add and select a provider config first
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_EndpointEmpty: Endpoint URL is empty - fill it in (or pick a provider to auto-fill)
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_KeyEmpty: API Key is empty - this provider requires an API Key
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_ModelEmpty: Model name is empty - fill in a model name (e.g. deepseek-chat / gpt-4o-mini)
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_Timeout: Connection timeout (20s) - network issue or wrong endpoint URL
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_Player2: Player2 desktop app not started or not ready. Make sure Player2 is running and retry
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_LocalModel: Local model service not running (Ollama / LM Studio not running or not listening on port 11434)
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_NoConn: Could not reach the server. Check network and endpoint URL
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_BadRequest: Bad request: most likely a wrong model name. Double-check the model
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_Auth: Authentication failed: API Key invalid or expired
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_Forbidden: Access denied: API Key lacks permission or account restricted
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_NotFound: Endpoint not found: endpoint URL may be wrong
LanguageData.QN_AI_E_Server: Server error: provider temporarily down. Try again later
LanguageData.QN_AI_T_ParseFail: Connected, but response parsing failed (chat may still work)\nRaw response: {0}
